LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDown.label: ranged cooldown reduction
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDown.description: Reduces the cooldown time of ranged weapons. This stat is used by RatHolic Gun spooling effect.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDownMultiplier.label: ranged cooldown multiplier
LanguageData.RK_Stat_RangeCoolDownMultiplier.descript: Multiplies the cooldown time of ranged weapons. This stat is used by RatHolic Gun spooling effect with statFactors.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldBlockChance.label: shield block chance
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldBlockChance.description:
Chance to attempt blocking an incoming attack with this shield.

If the attempt succeeds, a second armor roll (shield armor vs attacker AP) determines whether the attack is fully deflected.

Affected by melee skill, manipulation, and sight — identical modifiers to melee hit chance.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_DeflectAngle.label: shield deflect angle
LanguageData.RK_Stat_DeflectAngle.description: The total frontal arc (in degrees) within which this shield can deflect incoming attacks. For example, 90° means ±45° to each side.\n\nAffected by melee skill: low skill reduces the arc, high skill widens it (with diminishing returns).
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStuffBase.label: Shield Armor - Material effect multiplier
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Sharp.label: Shield Armor - Sharp
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Sharp.description: Shield protection against sharp damage like bullets, knife stabs, and animal bites.\n\nUsed in the shield deflect formula: higher values increase block chance against sharp attacks.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Blunt.label: Shield Armor - Blunt
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Blunt.description: Shield protection against blunt damage like fists, club impacts and rock falls.\n\nUsed in the shield deflect formula: higher values increase block chance against blunt attacks.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Heat.label: Shield Armor - Heat
LanguageData.RK_Stat_Shield_Heat.description: Shield protection against temperature-related damage like burns.\n\nUsed in the shield deflect formula: higher values increase block chance against heat attacks.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStamina.label: Shield max stamina
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStamina.description: The maximum stamina a shield can have at one time.\n\nMore stamina absorbs more damage.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaRechargeRate.label: Shield stamina recharge rate
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaRechargeRate.descri: The rate at which a shield gains stamina as long as it is not broken.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldReduceDamageMelee.label: Shield melee damage reduction
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldReduceDamageMelee.descript: The percentage of melee damage blocked by the shield.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldReduceDamageRanged.label: Shield ranged damage reduction
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldReduceDamageRanged.descrip: The percentage of ranged damage blocked by the shield.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldReduceDamageExplosive.desc: The percentage of explosive damage blocked by the shield.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaOnReset.label: Shield stamina on reset
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaOnReset.description: The amount of stamina restored when the shield recovers from being broken.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossMelee.label: Shield stamina loss per melee damage
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossMelee.descripti: The amount of shield stamina lost per point of melee damage received.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossRanged.label: Shield stamina loss per ranged damage
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossRanged.descript: The amount of shield stamina lost per point of ranged damage received.
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossExplosive.label: Shield stamina loss per explosive damage
LanguageData.RK_Stat_ShieldStaminaLossExplosive.descr: The amount of shield stamina lost per point of explosive damage received.
